#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate 'WE SHARE ONE HOME' — a universal, pictographic poster as SVG."""
import math, os

W, H = 1080, 1350
OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "output", "one-home.svg")

def person(x, ground, h, skin, clothes, accent, kind="adult"):
    """A simple, warm figure standing on `ground`, total height h."""
    head_r = max(13, h * 0.11)
    head_cy = ground - h + head_r
    body_top = head_cy + head_r + 6
    s = []
    if kind == "wheelchair":
        # seated figure + wheel
        s.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{head_cy}" r="{head_r}" fill="{skin}"/>')
        s.append(f'<path d="M {x-6} {body_top} L {x+22} {body_top+34} L {x+34} {ground-38}" stroke="{clothes}" stroke-width="22" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>')
        s.append(f'<path d="M {x-4} {body_top} L {x+8} {ground-52}" stroke="{clothes}" stroke-width="20" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>')
        s.append(f'<circle cx="{x+2}" cy="{ground-30}" r="28" fill="none" stroke="#EAF6FF" stroke-width="7"/>')
        s.append(f'<circle cx="{x+2}" cy="{ground-30}" r="5" fill="#EAF6FF"/>')
        return "".join(s), (x-30, head_cy+34), (x+36, head_cy+34)
    if kind == "child":
        bw = h * 0.20
        s.append(f'<rect x="{x-bw/2}" y="{body_top}" width="{bw}" height="{ground-body_top-22}" rx="14" fill="{clothes}"/>')
        s.append(f'<path d="M {x-bw/2+4} {ground-24} L {x-bw/2+2} {ground} M {x+bw/2-4} {ground-24} L {x+bw/2-2} {ground}" stroke="{accent}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>')
    elif kind == "dress":
        s.append(f'<path d="M {x} {body_top-6} L {x+30} {ground} L {x-30} {ground} Z" fill="{clothes}"/>')
        s.append(f'<rect x="{x-14}" y="{body_top-8}" width="28" height="30" rx="10" fill="{clothes}"/>')
    else:
        bw = h * 0.24
        s.append(f'<rect x="{x-bw/2}" y="{body_top}" width="{bw}" height="{(ground-body_top)*0.55}" rx="14" fill="{clothes}"/>')
        s.append(f'<path d="M {x-bw/2+7} {body_top+(ground-body_top)*0.5} L {x-bw/2+5} {ground} M {x+bw/2-7} {body_top+(ground-body_top)*0.5} L {x+bw/2-5} {ground}" stroke="{accent}" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/>')

        s.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{head_cy}" r="{head_r-2}" fill="{skin}"/>')
    elif kind == "turban":
        s.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{head_cy}" r="{head_r}" fill="{skin}"/>')
        s.append(f'<path d="M {x-head_r-3} {head_cy-4} A {head_r+3} {head_r} 0 1 1 {x+head_r+3} {head_cy-4} Z" fill="{accent}"/>')
        s.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{head_cy-head_r-2}" r="6" fill="{accent}"/>')
    elif kind == "elder":
        s.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{head_cy}" r="{head_r}" fill="{skin}"/>')
        s.append(f'<path d="M {x-head_r} {head_cy-2} A {head_r} {head_r} 0 1 1 {x+head_r} {head_cy-2} Z" fill="#E8E8E8"/>')
        s.append(f'<path d="M {x+28} {body_top+30} L {x+34} {ground}" stroke="#D9C9A8" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>')
    else:
        s.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{head_cy}" r="{head_r}" fill="{skin}"/>')
        s.append(f'<path d="M {x-head_r} {head_cy-3} A {head_r} {head_r} 0 1 1 {x+head_r} {head_cy-3} Z" fill="{accent}"/>')
    hand_y = body_top + (ground - body_top) * 0.28
    return "".join(s), (x - h*0.20, hand_y), (x + h*0.20, hand_y)
